translations.en: There was no sewage system. Waste was thrown out of the windows onto the road. This waste collected in gas holes in the road. These holes were so deep that people had to suffocate their noses when they walked through them.

translations.en: In the old days, people were more sick than they are now, so you don't have to worry. They didn't know where there was pollution. There were cities that were completely safe from the Juma and Black Jack kiwi plagues. Five of the Ten Children died when they were ten years old.
